season_garden_18_001.speaker: narrator
season_garden_18_001.text: The eighteenth paid afternoon began at the safe route beside the garden. The gardener had completed the current professional checks and invited the helpers to observe the selected planting within its accepted limits. Yue kept her shoulder supported during the small preparation at the table. Qiu brought the current general record instead of a fresh page promising improvement. Six sessions had passed since the last planting observation. Time had allowed change, but the change still needed an actual look before either woman could say what had happened.

season_garden_18_002.speaker: narrator
season_garden_18_002.text: Su confirmed the day's light assignments and the remaining term. This would be the eighteenth session, followed by nineteen and twenty if current staff decisions allowed the agreed work. Heavy gardening, plant care and site judgments remained with qualified staff. The old damaged tree ground still followed its own responsible process and had not become the new bed. Yue checked which small marker could be handled at the supported table. Qiu asked where their observation would end. The gardener named the permitted route and the actual current task.

season_garden_18_003.speaker: narrator
season_garden_18_003.text: The gardener brought the selected planting's record, with its real purchase and earlier observations. Annual seedlings and a young plum had different histories. One had been bought for three copper and the other for eight, according to Yue's actual decision, while the six copper bench repair belonged to both histories. Neither possible account could be borrowed to make the current garden look richer. Qiu read the source choice before opening the light observation sheet. Yue waited for the gardener to identify the living things they were actually permitted to describe.

season_garden_18_004.speaker: narrator
season_garden_18_004.text: The next observation would follow the selected planting through its own current facts. The annual bed could show confirmed development within a seasonal cycle; the young plum could show continuing establishment without supplying present shade. The gardener retained all trained judgments and care decisions. The helpers would copy only the permitted limited observation and perform the corresponding light marker work. Afterwards they would return to shared stock preparation. The unchosen planting remained unpurchased and unperformed, rather than waiting for the women to rescue it privately before their agreement ended.

season_garden_18_005.speaker: narrator
season_garden_18_005.text: Back at the supported table, the women placed the selected observation beside the general return list. The gardener held the detailed plant record and retained ongoing care. The helpers held only the permitted small marker work and a current general summary. Yue checked that the summary did not add a new purchase or an assurance about future growth. Qiu checked its actual date. The chosen living use had reached another real observation. It did not need to stand for the grandmother, repair the lost old canopy or prove which possible decision would have spared more sadness.

season_garden_18_006.speaker: narrator
season_garden_18_006.text: The gardener asked them to clean the removable lightweight marker after staff safely brought it to the table. Yue wiped the surface within her comfortable movement. Qiu read the current approved words from the plant record. The marker's purpose was ordinary information about the selected planting and staff care, not a memorial designation. A shallow stain remained after the dirt lifted. The gardener said it did not affect legibility and needed no replacement. The helpers kept the sound existing stock rather than buying a cleaner appearance through personal generosity.

season_garden_18_007.speaker: narrator
season_garden_18_007.text: A visitor asked whether the marker meant the planting would be ready for a particular family date. The gardener answered the actual growth question, with its uncertainty and limited purpose. Yue did not promise a view or future flower display to make the visitor's plan easier. Qiu supplied the current permitted route direction after the responsible worker approved it. The visitor thanked them and moved on. A small public record could help someone understand what existed without becoming a reservation for an outcome the garden had never guaranteed.

season_garden_18_008.speaker: narrator
season_garden_18_008.text: The question made Yue remember the grandmother's wish for yellow and her willingness to look at green. She could recall the offered words without claiming the woman would have approved every later stage. Qiu said the planting's current record did not need an imagined blessing. Yue agreed and kept the private thought off the marker. The actual ordinary garden use belonged to more than one life. That fact did not cancel the loss of the particular woman who had asked to see it, and the loss did not change the selected receipt.

season_garden_18_009.speaker: narrator
season_garden_18_009.text: The responsible worker returned the cleaned marker to its accepted position while the helpers stayed on the permitted route. Yue checked the plain writing from the ordinary standing place. Qiu checked the indicated lower sight line without stepping into the bed. The words remained legible. The gardener retained authority over the placement and any future correction. Their limited check concerned the paper and visible words in this setting. It did not certify plant health, guarantee safe use for every visitor or authorize a change to the old restricted ground.

season_garden_18_010.speaker: narrator
season_garden_18_010.text: Their next shared task concerned small stock that would remain after the helpers' term. The gardener supplied a permitted inventory of light general materials and their accepted storage places. Yue counted the assigned blank markers and loose cloth samples at the supported table. Qiu checked the record against the actual stock. They did not open unrelated packets or private forms to make the list comprehensive. The receiver wanted a finite list of the things the women had actually handled, with unused stock returned and no unseen project folded into the account.

season_garden_18_011.speaker: narrator
season_garden_18_011.text: A loose general marker had been stored with an old draft naming the previous observation. The gardener retained one comparison copy in the plant record and authorized removing the spare from current use. Yue returned the spare to the specified ordinary reuse stock after confirming it contained no private information. Qiu put the retained copy in the gardener's folder. The current marker and historical observation now had separate places. Keeping evidence of change did not require leaving outdated words where visitors might mistake them for the garden's present statement.

season_garden_18_012.speaker: narrator
season_garden_18_012.text: Su checked whether the stock return required another materials expenditure. It did not. All small work used existing approved stock, and the selected planting's earlier bill remained the only planting purchase. Yue asked whether unused markers could be transferred to a different household as a gift. The gardener said they belonged to garden stock and would remain there unless a responsible owner separately authorized a release. Qiu put them back. Wanting an object to be useful elsewhere did not make the helpers its owners or supply them with permission to give it away.

season_garden_18_013.speaker: narrator
season_garden_18_013.text: At the first agreed pause, Yue rested her shoulder and looked beyond the table without searching for another task. Qiu supported her elbow and let the gauge stay closed. The gardener continued ordinary care elsewhere under the accepted rota. The sight made Yue feel less central to the planting than she had during its first purchase. She felt relief and a small hurt together. Qiu said being able to leave was one of the practical conditions they had required before accepting the work. The condition was now becoming visible through other people's continued presence.

season_garden_18_014.speaker: narrator
season_garden_18_014.text: Qiu described her shorter sister visit only in the ordinary details she could share. The snack had arrived intact, and her sister had preferred half before leaving the rest for later. Qiu had stayed for the accepted time and then left when rest was wanted. Yue asked whether leaving had been difficult. Qiu said yes, but nobody had needed her to turn the difficulty into another hour. The visit belonged to their relationship and its actual invitation. It was not garden labor, a clinical intervention or evidence that every family boundary had become easy.

season_garden_18_015.speaker: narrator
season_garden_18_015.text: Yue had kept the shorter route home after the last session and had felt better for the ordinary rest. She did not offer that as medical advice to Qiu. Their limits differed, and professional healers retained their own clinical judgments. Qiu asked whether Yue wanted company on the same route today if their plans aligned. Yue checked her actual comfort and said yes for the shared portion. The offered company remained small enough to be answered honestly. It did not bind either woman to future walks simply because this one sounded kind.

season_garden_18_016.speaker: narrator
season_garden_18_016.text: When the pause ended, the responsible hall worker brought the current maintenance handover sheet from indoors. Its practical places still matched the arrangement checked at the seventeenth session. The selected teaching format had supplied the first actual handover, and the current shared checks had improved the instructions since then. No second unchosen format had been added. Yue compared the plain source conditions with the general summary the gardener had just retained. Different practical records could share care about limits while staying under their own responsible owners.

season_garden_18_017.speaker: narrator
season_garden_18_017.text: The hall worker wanted a small correction in the final return list: the permitted general copy released to a receiver should be listed as released, rather than as missing stock. Qiu made the correction and included the limited source conditions attached at release. Yue checked that the current source sheet still remained with the worker. Private original papers and clinical forms were absent. The list now accounted for an actual movement instead of hiding it under a neat count. The receiver would need that accuracy when accepting the final materials, even if every object could not be physically present.

season_garden_18_018.speaker: narrator
season_garden_18_018.text: A willing user had tried the current drying instruction during an ordinary duty and supplied a brief report through the worker. The cloth had reached its specified place, and the ownership caution had prompted a consultation about a different paper. The worker had handled that private paper through its proper return process. Yue recorded only the relevant general observation. Qiu left the private contents and person's circumstances out. Their sheet had helped someone ask the responsible person rather than guess, which was an actual limited result within its approved ordinary purpose.

season_garden_18_019.speaker: narrator
season_garden_18_019.text: The report did not test every sentence or every future condition. Yue wanted to call the instruction dependable and stopped at the observed facts. Qiu added the date and actual scope rather than a broad verdict. The responsible worker retained the method and could change it through future use. The helpers' final account would name that ownership. No successful ordinary action qualified either woman to teach clinical exercises, interpret symptoms or advise a family about what grief should look like. The record remained useful because its modest boundaries stayed attached.

season_garden_18_020.speaker: narrator
season_garden_18_020.text: The gardener then requested a short general direction for visitors who wanted to ask about the planting after the term ended. The wording would point to the responsible gardener through the site's ordinary process. Yue drafted it with the role named plainly. Qiu checked that it did not send people to the helpers' private homes or imply they were available between sessions. The gardener approved the current practical direction and retained it. A living planting could continue to receive care and questions without making the women permanent custodians of its future.

season_garden_18_021.speaker: narrator
season_garden_18_021.text: The new direction used existing paper, and staff handled its accepted placement. Yue copied one plain reminder for her private notebook: the current garden contact belonged to staff. She did not write the gardener's personal circumstances or an informal promise of immediate answers. Qiu returned the draft surplus to authorized reuse stock. The actual useful paper stayed with the receiver. Their term had accepted light help for twenty sessions, not a continuing public service attached to two personal names. That distinction could appear in ordinary words without sounding like rejection of the garden.

season_garden_18_022.speaker: narrator
season_garden_18_022.text: The bench owner arrived with a small household bundle unrelated to the helpers' work. She wanted to sit outside if the current ordinary route remained open. Staff answered the site question. Yue greeted her and did not attach a planting update she had not requested. The woman asked one anyway, then listened to the current general summary without being expected to prefer it. Qiu saw her look toward an established orchard plum farther along the permitted view. That tree belonged to its own ordinary owner and care, separate from whichever first planting Yue had selected.

season_garden_18_023.speaker: narrator
season_garden_18_023.text: The owner said the established plum had dropped several leaves in the last wind and still looked much too leafy for her liking when sweeping was needed. Yue smiled at the complaint. The tree was intact and remained under its ordinary care; the owner was describing fallen material, not offering a cutting or asking the helpers to damage it. Qiu said the leaves were handsome from where they stood. The woman answered that handsomeness did not sweep a path. Their conversation stayed ordinary, with no promise that a leaf could provide medicine or replace a person's private keepsake.

season_garden_18_024.speaker: narrator
season_garden_18_024.text: Yue liked the glimpse of the established tree as something already living beyond this term. It did not owe its existence to her planting choice. Its present leaves were separate from the annual bed or the young plum's new establishment. Qiu asked whether Yue had been mentally claiming the whole orchard as the result of their work. Yue admitted she sometimes enlarged a small contribution until it seemed to hold the whole place together. The owner's sweeping complaint returned the tree to a life of its own, including work the helpers had never performed.

season_garden_18_025.speaker: narrator
season_garden_18_025.text: The owner went on to her chosen seat after staff gave the current ordinary direction. She did not offer a leaf today, and the women did not collect one from the ground without permission. Yue returned to the assigned table. Qiu checked the small stock count again after the movement around the route. Their general work could include noticing something beautiful without acquiring it. A later real offer would need its own owner, object and answer. For now the established plum remained intact in its ordinary garden, beyond the women's finite inventory.

season_garden_18_026.speaker: narrator
season_garden_18_026.text: At the next pause, Yue said she had begun dreading the final account because it would make the remaining money visible. Qiu asked whether she wanted to spend it to avoid feeling unfinished. Yue said part of her did. Su joined the pause long enough to clarify that the allowance had a maximum and an actual purpose, not a duty to become empty. Unused money would return through the authorized account. The earlier storm had reduced labor performed, and the selected planting had cost what its receipt said. Neither fact required another task to make the subtraction feel emotionally complete.

season_garden_18_027.speaker: narrator
season_garden_18_027.text: Qiu said she had felt tempted to buy a small extra cloth with her own wages. The responsible worker had already confirmed existing stock was sufficient. Yue asked whether the proposed cloth served the hall or served Qiu's wish to arrive with a final gift. Qiu said mostly the latter. They did not make the purchase a garden commitment. A personal desire could be reconsidered privately without becoming a hidden donation in the public account. Their paid contribution did not need to consume their earned coins before it counted as care.

season_garden_18_028.speaker: narrator
season_garden_18_028.text: The family gathering had ended at its actual occasion, and the chosen first improvement had reached its finite use. The final account would not reopen that decision or make private grief into a remaining task. Yue remembered one willing speaker's pause and left the family words with the family. Qiu remembered the ordinary cup she had held. The child's original drawing and pinwheel still had their owners, with no fresh permission for a public copy. Useful maintenance materials could pass to staff without bringing those private objects along to make the handover more moving.

season_garden_18_029.speaker: narrator
season_garden_18_029.text: When work resumed, the gardener reviewed the small observation summary against the actual plant record. One word Yue had chosen sounded like a promise of continuing improvement. The gardener replaced it with the current observed development. Qiu read the corrected sentence and found it less hopeful in tone but more accurate. Yue accepted the change. Hope could remain part of their private response to living growth. The general record needed the facts the responsible person could support today, with the care arrangement and uncertainty still visible to anyone reading later.

season_garden_18_030.speaker: narrator
season_garden_18_030.text: The gardener retained the detailed observation and the accepted general summary. The hall worker retained the maintenance sheet and revised return list. Su retained the treasury account. Yue noticed that three competent receivers now held three different useful records. She did not need a master copy containing everything. Qiu asked whether the final term file should at least refer to their actual destinations. Su said yes, in the practical scope required for closure. Referring to who held a record could be useful without copying its contents or transferring its authority to the helpers.

season_garden_18_031.speaker: narrator
season_garden_18_031.text: They checked the assigned small stock for any personal paper mixed in by habit. Yue found her own folded arrival reminder under a blank marker and removed it to her notebook. Qiu found no family letter among the practice pieces. The current staff papers remained with their receivers. The check took little time and prevented later guessing. Yue almost left the reminder because it contained nothing sensitive. It still belonged to her, and the receiver had not asked to keep it. Actual custody could be precise without requiring every mistaken extra to pose a dramatic risk.

season_garden_18_032.speaker: narrator
season_garden_18_032.text: The last light task involved folding the loose clean cloth samples according to the worker's accepted storage. Qiu handled one within her elbow limit; Yue handled the smaller piece from her supported position. Staff would carry the larger bundle. They did not increase their movements because the session was nearly over. The work's smallness made it easier to underestimate its accumulated demand. Both women stated the current comfortable range and finished within it. Professional healers retained medical decisions, and the practical storage arrangement adjusted to the helpers' actual accepted capacity.

season_garden_18_033.speaker: narrator
season_garden_18_033.text: A willing worker checked the stock list as the samples returned. One item had a different ordinary name in her duty record. The responsible worker confirmed the two names referred to the same loose sample and approved a plain clarification. Yue added the accepted name without creating a second object in the count. Qiu compared the revised list against the tray once more. The future receiver would be able to check the actual stock. A name difference had become a useful correction instead of an argument about who remembered the room more accurately.

season_garden_18_034.speaker: narrator
season_garden_18_034.text: The gardener said the selected planting would continue under the ordinary accepted rota after the helpers finished. There was no request for them to water privately or appear between sessions. Yue thanked the gardener and let the statement become practical evidence, rather than a permission to stop caring emotionally. Qiu said she would still enjoy hearing a permitted update if one happened to reach her. The gardener made no standing report promise. Future interest could remain welcome without acquiring an obligation to supply news to the women who had once helped with a marker.

season_garden_18_035.speaker: narrator
season_garden_18_035.text: Su recorded the eighteenth completed three hour session and paid each helper three copper. Each woman had now worked fifty three hours and received fifty three copper in the new term. Combined labor spending reached one hundred six, leaving fourteen held before the final two sessions. If both full sessions occurred, twelve more would be paid and two would remain unused. The earlier unworked storm hour stayed unpaid and unscheduled. Yue and Qiu checked their payments, with no charge added for the private feelings that had made parts of the afternoon difficult.

season_garden_18_036.speaker: narrator
season_garden_18_036.text: No new materials purchase had occurred. The actual selected planting and completed bench repair still determined the materials balance. The gardener's ongoing care used its accepted existing arrangements, not an invisible new helper grant. Su kept the branch's real receipt ready for the twentieth account. The small marker and instruction work used existing stock. Yue closed her purse before thanking the receivers. Their wages belonged to them, while unused allowance belonged to its authorized return. The ordinary distinction did not make either woman's contribution smaller than the work she had actually completed.

season_garden_18_037.speaker: narrator
season_garden_18_037.text: The responsible staff retained the current useful materials in their own accepted places. The gardener held the plant observation and general direction. The hall worker held the methods, practical returns and one specified comparison record. The helpers took their own notebooks and personal drafts. Family objects and patient papers remained absent from the packet. Qiu checked her private drawing was still with her rather than offered as an untested gift. Yue found the table easier to leave now that its remaining papers could be named by actual receiver instead of vague importance.

season_garden_18_038.speaker: narrator
season_garden_18_038.text: They arranged the nineteenth paid arrival with current plans in mind. Yue kept her family time and shoulder rest on the calendar. Qiu kept the sister visit arrangement and her own elbow limits. Neither accepted a hidden shift to polish the final account. The remaining work would take place within the agreed sessions, with staff directing any changes required by current conditions. Su said the twentieth receiver checks were still planned. The statement concerned a real future date, and no one treated it as proof that the garden could no longer ask a new question.

season_garden_18_039.speaker: narrator
season_garden_18_039.text: On the shared portion of the walk home, Yue said the planting looked more itself each time she saw it. Qiu asked whether that meant Yue liked every consequence of her choice. Yue said no. The other wish could remain worthwhile without becoming secretly performed. Qiu nodded and mentioned the established owner's complaint about leaves. Its tree had supplied a conversation beyond their selected bed. Yue liked that the garden could surprise them through lives they had not arranged. They parted at the actual turn, with the next session still finite and the evening open to their own ordinary plans.

season_garden_18_annuals_01.speaker: narrator
season_garden_18_annuals_01.text: At the annual bed actually selected, the gardener began with fifteen confirmed seedlings from the twelfth observation. One additional plant could now be distinguished using the gardener's ordinary identifying features, making sixteen confirmed seedlings today. Yue copied the number after the responsible person showed which one was new. Qiu kept the unsprouted positions separate from the count. The four retained seeds remained in proper storage, with no additional sowing authorized. A larger number could feel gratifying without allowing the helpers to create another planting through enthusiasm or private work.

season_garden_18_annuals_02.speaker: narrator
season_garden_18_annuals_02.text: Two of the established annual plants showed small formed buds under the gardener's current observation. The responsible person identified them and retained the growth judgment. Yue wanted to say color was finally near. The gardener explained the remaining ordinary uncertainty and declined to promise a date or a complete display. Qiu wrote the limited visible finding beside the seedling count. The bed could offer more than it had before while still refusing the calendar the women imagined. The present green and small buds were the actual useful view, not a substitute promised bloom.

season_garden_18_annuals_03.speaker: narrator
season_garden_18_annuals_03.text: A visitor said the bed looked patchier than the picture she had formed from the word flowers. Qiu answered with the gardener's approved plain description of the modest selected planting. Yue did not defend the bed by claiming all the empty positions would fill. The gardener explained the current development and ordinary care. The visitor looked again and said she could see the two buds from the permitted route. Her changed attention was one person's actual response. It did not oblige her to call the arrangement beautiful or make the unchosen young tree appear in this history.

season_garden_18_annuals_04.speaker: narrator
season_garden_18_annuals_04.text: The gardener checked the safe boundary marker and assigned a small staff adjustment after ordinary use had shifted one edge. Yue did not move the installed border herself. The lightweight information piece could be cleaned later at the supported table once staff brought it in. Qiu read the current plant wording before marking the new observation. The helpers' role remained the permitted light preparation and copied general facts. Trained care, installation and site judgments belonged to the gardener and responsible workers, even where the needed movement looked deceptively easy from the route.

season_garden_18_annuals_05.speaker: narrator
season_garden_18_annuals_05.text: Yue remembered the grandmother looking at an earlier green update and liking what she actually saw. She did not know how the woman would have felt about today's sixteen seedlings or two buds. Qiu said the earlier conversation could stay true without being stretched across every future stage. Yue felt disappointed by the limit and grateful for it. The annual selection had not guaranteed flowers before the family farewell, and its later development did not retroactively fulfill a promise never made. The grandmother's own words remained smaller, private and more certain than an imagined blessing.

season_garden_18_annuals_06.speaker: narrator
season_garden_18_annuals_06.text: A child visiting with an accompanying adult asked whether the buds would open when he next came. The gardener gave the actual uncertain answer. Yue said he could look from the permitted route if his adult and staff arranged another ordinary visit. She did not promise a date or copy the child's private drawing onto the marker to reward his interest. He preferred a definite answer and said so. Qiu agreed it would be pleasant to know. The bed's living timing could remain uncertain while the child retained the right to find that unsatisfying.

season_garden_18_annuals_07.speaker: narrator
season_garden_18_annuals_07.text: The gardener reviewed the annual care arrangement after the helper term. Ordinary staff would maintain the accepted modest bed under the existing rota and water plan. The seasonal cycle and eventual end handling remained part of that responsibility. Yue would not sow the retained seeds privately or come to water between sessions. Qiu checked that the general source conditions said selected annual bed and named the responsible gardener. A useful public description could identify the current living use without extending the women's finite work into the rest of the growing season.

season_garden_18_annuals_08.speaker: narrator
season_garden_18_annuals_08.text: The materials account for this actual selection still showed three copper for annual stock and suitable light planting materials. With the completed six copper bench repair, materials spending remained nine and thirty one remained from the forty copper allocation. No new purchase followed from buds, unsprouted positions or the desire for a fuller bed. Su checked the receipt against the treasury record. Yue copied no supplier details into a public story. The account needed its actual bill and authorized balance, while the gardener's plant record carried the observed development.

season_garden_18_annuals_09.speaker: narrator
season_garden_18_annuals_09.text: Qiu read the current permitted summary aloud: sixteen confirmed seedlings, two plants with visible formed buds, further development uncertain and staff care continuing. The gardener corrected one phrase that implied every seedling had a bud. Yue amended it immediately. Qiu tried the words again from the route. They now described the specific limited finding. The record would not become brighter by blending different plants into one ideal bed. The actual distribution mattered to the person who would later compare growth, even when a shorter sentence sounded more satisfying.

season_garden_18_annuals_10.speaker: narrator
season_garden_18_annuals_10.text: The annual marker did not describe the bed as a memorial. No responsible owner or family had given that designation, and the ordinary planting served more than one person's view. Yue checked the wording against that scope while Qiu prepared the clean space for its update. The bench owner's private history, the grandmother's patient papers and the child's drawing stayed absent. The current general facts were sufficient. Care could be visible in an ordinary garden record without making a private death the reason every visitor was expected to admire the selected seedlings.

season_garden_18_annuals_11.speaker: narrator
season_garden_18_annuals_11.text: The gardener accepted the limited observation for the general summary and retained the fuller care record. Yue handed over the copied current facts with their date and source conditions. Qiu returned the unused blank marker to stock. The unchosen young plum had not been bought, planted or given an imaginary leaf count in this history. Its worthwhile possible future remained outside this purchase and term. The annual bed's present development could be enjoyed without claiming the women had delivered both color now and future tree shade through one finite decision.

season_garden_18_annuals_12.speaker: narrator
season_garden_18_annuals_12.text: They left the bed on the permitted route after the gardener named the next staff care responsibility. Yue looked once more at the small buds without assigning them a deadline. Qiu said she still wished the grandmother could have seen them. Yue said so did she. The wish did not change what had been observed or what had been promised. Their actual annual work had reached its eighteenth session check. The selected summary and marker would now return to the shared light preparation, while trained continuing care remained with the gardener.

season_garden_18_plum_01.speaker: narrator
season_garden_18_plum_01.text: At the young plum actually selected, the gardener began with five opened leaves confirmed during the twelfth observation. Two more were now visibly opened, making seven in today's limited count. Yue copied the number after the gardener identified the actual leaves. Qiu kept the small count separate from her imagined future canopy. The tree still offered no present shade or fruit. It had been bought for establishment under staff care, and the current observation concerned that modest living start rather than a mature tree secretly supplied by the women's wish for a satisfying result.

season_garden_18_plum_02.speaker: narrator
season_garden_18_plum_02.text: The gardener checked the support and living stem using trained judgment. One small adjustment belonged to that professional care and was performed by the responsible person. Yue kept her hands on the permitted note at the supported surface. Qiu did not offer the gauge as a substitute for the gardener's knowledge. The tiny difference between room for growth and insufficient support could not be decided by the helpers' preference for a tidy line. Their copied observation would name the staff check without turning it into a method they were qualified to teach or repeat.

season_garden_18_plum_03.speaker: narrator
season_garden_18_plum_03.text: A visitor asked whether seven leaves meant the tree had safely established. The gardener gave the actual current assessment with its ordinary continuing uncertainty. Yue did not turn a count into a guarantee. Qiu read the approved general description of continuing establishment under staff care. The visitor looked at the small tree and said she had expected something larger. Yue acknowledged its present size. The receipt had purchased suitable young stock and required materials, not a crown that could restore the old shade or satisfy every person's image of a plum.

season_garden_18_plum_04.speaker: narrator
season_garden_18_plum_04.text: The gardener reviewed the protected boundary and asked the helpers to prepare the lightweight general marker after staff safely removed it for cleaning. Yue would wipe its face at the supported table. Qiu would compare the accepted words with the current observation. The installed support and bed arrangements stayed under staff authority. The old damaged tree ground remained separate. A visible living tree did not grant the helpers a right to change adjacent site conditions, and a small marker did not become their certificate that every future use of the route was safe.

season_garden_18_plum_05.speaker: narrator
season_garden_18_plum_05.text: Yue remembered saying the future tree would serve a garden used by more than one life. Today the thought still felt true and did not feel easier. The grandmother had not lived to see the seven leaves. Qiu said the young tree's continuing life could be ordinary without correcting that loss. Yue nodded and left the private sentence off the marker. The selected planting had never promised to keep a particular person present until it grew. A living future could remain worthwhile while the present retained an absence the tree could not repair.

season_garden_18_plum_06.speaker: narrator
season_garden_18_plum_06.text: A child visiting with an accompanying adult asked whether the plum would have fruit soon. The gardener explained the young stock's actual stage and declined to promise fruit in the present season. Yue offered no household story about miraculous early trees. Qiu asked whether the child wanted to look at the seven leaves from the permitted route. He did, then said seven sounded like very few. Yue agreed that the tree was still small. His disappointment could remain an honest response without making the count wrong or requiring the helpers to buy an additional tree.

season_garden_18_plum_07.speaker: narrator
season_garden_18_plum_07.text: The gardener confirmed ordinary continuing care beyond the twentieth helper session. Water, support checks and current plant decisions remained on the accepted staff rota. Yue would not come privately to tighten ties or water between sessions. Qiu checked the general direction named the responsible gardener rather than the helpers. Their useful light participation had always depended on actual care continuing elsewhere. The seventh leaf did not purchase more of their time. The plan could support a future the women cared about without making that future dependent on their unpaid availability.

season_garden_18_plum_08.speaker: narrator
season_garden_18_plum_08.text: The materials account for this actual selection still showed eight copper for the young plum and required planting materials. With the completed six copper bench repair, materials spending remained fourteen and twenty six remained from the forty copper allocation. No new purchase followed from a support adjustment performed within the existing arrangement. Su checked the receipt against the treasury record. Yue did not add the annual packet as a compensating expense. The other wish remained unperformed, and the real selected tree kept its actual modest bill rather than an emotionally balanced account of both possibilities.

season_garden_18_plum_09.speaker: narrator
season_garden_18_plum_09.text: Qiu read the permitted summary aloud: seven visibly opened leaves at today's limited observation, continuing establishment and staff care. The gardener changed one phrase that sounded as though the helpers had judged the tree's health from the count. Yue copied the correction. The new sentence made the gardener's assessment and the helpers' copied observation distinct. That distinction mattered more than making the note sound confident. A public reader could know what had been seen and who retained responsibility without being encouraged to treat the count as a universal measure of a young tree's prospects.

season_garden_18_plum_10.speaker: narrator
season_garden_18_plum_10.text: The marker did not call the new plum a replacement for the old removed tree or a memorial for the grandmother. Its accepted ordinary position and purpose remained its own. The bench owner's private history, the patient's papers and the child's drawing stayed absent from the general record. Yue liked leaving the tree room to become inconvenient in ways nobody had imagined. Qiu remembered the owner's remark about future leaves needing sweeping. Neither private reflection became an official prediction. The present tree could remain seven leaves and a continuing staff care arrangement.

season_garden_18_plum_11.speaker: narrator
season_garden_18_plum_11.text: The gardener accepted the copied current observation for the general summary and retained the fuller professional record. Yue handed over the date and source conditions with the words. Qiu returned the unused blank marker to stock. The unchosen annual bed had not been bought, sown or given imaginary buds in this history. Its possible color remained a worthwhile other future outside the selected purchase. The young plum's actual development could be enjoyed without claiming one finite decision had delivered both seasonal flowers and a future canopy through hidden extra money or labor.

season_garden_18_plum_12.speaker: narrator
season_garden_18_plum_12.text: They left the young tree on the permitted route after the gardener named the continuing staff responsibility. Yue looked back at the sparse leaves without enlarging them into shade. Qiu said she still wished the grandmother could have seen what existed now. Yue said so did she. The wish did not revise the purchase or create a promise about who would live to enjoy future growth. Their actual selected plum work had reached its eighteenth session observation. The summary and light marker now returned to shared preparation, while trained ordinary care stayed with the gardener.

season_garden_18_growth_gate.speaker: narrator
season_garden_18_growth_gate.text: The gardener opened the current observation for the planting actually selected on the fifth session and purchased on the sixth. The annual bed and young plum had different living facts, receipts and care needs, which their later checks had preserved. Yue and Qiu would follow that actual history today, copying only the permitted limited observation and preparing its lightweight marker. No second planting had entered the term. Afterwards the shared stock return and maintenance checks would continue, with professional staff retaining plant judgments and ongoing responsibility.
